headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (7)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Bahrain Grand Prix from pole position, 12.0s ahead of Sergio Perez, with Fernando Alonso completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P20 to P9.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P11 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised OCO (5 second time penalty), OCO (10 second time penalty), OCO (5 second time penalty), HUL (5 second time penalty) and HUL (10 second time penalty).
Max Verstappen takes the championship lead, 7 points ahead of Sergio Perez.
